item.title: Guwahati: Assam Governor Meets 6 Indian Foreign Service Officers at Lok Bhavan
item.description: Assam Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya on Monday interacted with six Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer trainees of the 2025 batch at Lok Bhavan in Guwahati. item.title: 10,000 Special Guests From Across India Invited for 77th Republic Day Parade
item.description: Around 10,000 special guests from across the country have been invited to witness the 77th Republic Day Parade at Kartavya Path, New Delhi, on January 26, 2026, the Ministry of Defence said on Monday. item.title: India in Pole Position to Become Upper-Middle-Income Country by 2030: SBI Research
item.description: India is firmly positioned to transition into an upper-middle-income country by 2030 and is projected to become the world’s third-largest economy by 2028, according to the latest report by SBI Research. The report highlights a sharp acceleration in India’s growth trajectory over the past decade, placing the country in the 95th percentile of the global growth distribution for the decade ending 2024. item.title: Guwahati: Hatigaon Police Arrests Man For Duping People on Pretext of Govt Jobs
item.description: The Hatigaon police in Guwahati arrested Banikanta Medhi on Monday following a complaint of fraud by a victim. Medhi has been accused of defrauding people on the pretext of fake government job offerings. Medhi, 37, was detained on Sunday from his Satgaon residence and arrested today after the police gathered evidence against him. item.description: As Assam marked its first-ever participation at the World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos on Monday, Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma said the state is steadily building a strong industrial ecosystem, with Guwahati emerging as the talent hub of the entire Northeast. item.title: WATCH: Armed Robbers Loot Guwahati Businessman’s Home; Family Members Attacked
item.description: A shocking robbery took place late Monday night in Guwahati’s Ganeshpara area. item.title: Blast at Chinese Restaurant in Afghanistan Kills 7, Several Injured
item.description: At least seven people lost their lives and more than a dozen others were injured after an explosion ripped through a Chinese restaurant in Afghanistan’s Kabul on Monday afternoon. item.title: Kokrajhar Mob Attack: Man Burnt Alive Inside Car, Four Others Injured; Police Detain 18
item.description: Tensions prevailed in Assam’s Kokrajhar district following a brutal mob attack reported late Monday night in Karigaon area, leaving one person dead and four others seriously injured. According to sources, a Scorpio vehicle was also set on fire following the mob attack which is reportedly linked to a contract-related dispute. item.title: CM Vigilance Raids DFO's Residence in Guwahati in Corruption Case
item.description: The Chief Minister’s Vigilance Cell on Tuesday conducted a raid at the residence of a Divisional Forest Officer (DFO) in Guwahati in connection with an alleged disproportionate assets case.
